description: Any left inverse of a map equals any right inverse of that map. Consequently, a two-sided inverse, when it exists, is unique.
signature:
Function.LeftInverse.eq_rightInverse.{u_1, u_2} {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {f : α → β} {g₁ g₂ : β → α}
  (h₁ : Function.LeftInverse g₁ f) (h₂ : Function.RightInverse g₂ f) : g₁ = g₂
